documents.title: Lonoke County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 225 pages. Amounts are the Rightmost 2026 column of each form ('Appropriation 2026'; on a few forms 'Amount Requested 2026'; on p. 84 the third column 'Appropriation 2026'), category 'TOTAL ...' lines and 'TOTAL APPROPRIATION' column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
